label: D2 after a1 reached S1 (common), unless S1 has just paid off twice in a row
explanation: 97% of activation mass is at D2 with state input S1; essentially only on a1->S1 common transitions (a2->S1 rare almost never fires). Never fires at GO or on S2. It fires on 40% of a1->S1c D2 steps; magnitude is graded by recent history: largest when the previous reward was 0 or the last trial went rare to S2, and it decays across a run of consecutive rewarded a1->S1c trials (e.g. 0.96, 0.73, 0.48, 0.25, then off). Excluding D2 steps where the two previous trials were rewarded and the last one reached S1 raises F1 from 0.55 to 0.60 at 0.94 mass recall. Firing also declines across the episode (rate 8% in trials 0-19 to 1% in trials 90-99); adding ep_trial<80 gives F1 0.63, which I did not record. Small D1 tail (2.6% mass): D1 after an unrewarded S1c trial. Uses only observed variables. Reads like an S1-arrival signal scaled by how unexpected or un-reinforced S1 currently is (low recent S1 reward).
